name: Wildwasser-Rafting Ötztaler Ache
beschreibung: === description === Adventure and adrenaline on the Ötztaler Ache! Join a guided rafting tour and tackle the thrilling rapids of the wild Tiroler mountain river together with experienced guides. Between the exciting sections, take a moment to marvel at the breathtaking gorge scenery. All necessary gear, including wetsuits, is provided—ideal for teams and adventurers aged 14 and up.
